interface.name: zclear_inspector_v1

description.summary: query information about client surface states and layouts

interface.description: This interface allows cce-ui client applications to register their surfaces and publish their internal widget trees and state to the compositor. It also allows inspector tools to request the list of active surfaces and their states.

request.name: register_client

description.summary: register a wl_surface as a cce-ui client window

request.description: Associate a client wl_surface with this inspector.

request.name: update_state

description.summary: update the published state of a registered client surface

request.description: The state is serialized as a JSON string containing widget layout and state data.

description.summary: request the list of all registered surfaces from the compositor
reports a registered surface's state and absolute coordinates
indicates all inspected surfaces have been reported
